registry_correction: Registry 'Income Tax Act (Cap. 123)' confirmed: personal exemption $30,080 (s 28, since 1 January 2020), then 11/23/35/40 % (Fifth Schedule brackets 15,000/30,000/60,000); SINPF employee 5 cents per complete dollar of monthly wages (employer 12.5).
